payload.title: anthus-site-content CI: build against Anth.us-Papyrus instead of the retired Gatsby site; track content main
payload.description: After the 2026-10-04 cutover, AnthusAI/anthus-site-content's .github/workflows/ci.yml still builds every push/PR against AnthusAI/Anth.us develop (Gatsby), which cannot compile the converted Papyrus markup, so it now fails permanently (first failure: PR #18 / push of 074c1fb). Replace it with a check that builds the content through Anth.us-Papyrus (Papyrus pin from its amplify.yml) and fails on build/guard assertion errors. Also switch the Anth.us-Papyrus submodule to track content main (.gitmodules branch) and bump the pin to content main, now that #18 is merged. Then wire automatic production builds (Git-connected Amplify builds or a deploy job) so content pushes publish without the manual zip step.
